Gold Purity Guide

Understand Gold Karats Before Buying

Gold purity is commonly expressed using karats. Understanding the difference can help you choose jewellery according to your needs and budget.

24K

99.9% gold purity and commonly used as the reference for pure gold pricing.

22K

Around 91.6% gold and widely used for traditional jewellery.

21K

87.5% gold and used in a variety of jewellery designs.

18K

75% gold with additional metals for improved strength and durability.
